name: Fufluns

source.map_area_convention: [left, top, right, bottom]; right and bottom exclusive; pixels of original image; x right, y down
source.outline_basis: Visible main roof/building envelope, simplified around rounded ends; footprint under eaves, roof equipment and marker-obscured areas approximate.
source.geometry_convention: Clockwise outlines in y-down image coordinates, not repeated closed vertex. Roof/main structure envelopes are simplified; obscured ground footprints are approximate. height_m is roof height above local ground/platform, not absolute terrain altitude.
source.rotation_convention: rotation_deg is clockwise from image +x to the first polygon edge, modulo 180; positive y points down. It is a drafting reference edge, not necessarily the pad long axis or in-game heading.

scale.how: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
scale.basis: User-confirmed classes, user working dimensions Large170x90m, Medium135x70m, Small70x50m.
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

fingerprint.description: Three HAB buildings form a north-south column on the left, with two small and two large-looking pads beside a long eastward bridge to an isolated PWR building.
fingerprint.notes: Original tracing note; pad-class statements are superseded by the verified size field, while visible-geometry observations remain applicable: HAB count follows visible HAB labels; pad-size counts follow provisional low-confidence visual size classifications.

buildings.label: HAB
buildings.notes: Two broad rounded HAB wings and a narrow southern extension. Roof and platform edges are partly hidden by icons; north-facing wall is poorly visible in the angled view. Two occupied levels are a low-confidence visual estimate, not inferred from access numbers/carets.

buildings.label: HAB
buildings.notes: Central rectangular HAB; eave/main roof envelope. One occupied level and roughly 6 m to the main roof estimated from the angled view; elevated ground/platform is not included in roof height.

buildings.label: HAB
buildings.notes: Southern HAB repeats much of northern module with its narrow extension pointing north. The angled image exposes two height tiers but not enough detail to confirm floor count; 2 is a low-confidence estimate.

buildings.label: PWR
buildings.notes: Power building main structural cluster, including short attached bays. Roof equipment is simplified; exact eastern wall and console room are covered by icons. One occupied level with taller machinery volume is a low-confidence estimate.

Small unlabelled roofed utility unit at the lower end of the north large-pad western L-shaped service cluster. It is separate from existing small-pad service-small-n. Height and single-level count are LOW exterior estimates from the angled reference; exact function and interior floors are unconfirmed.

Small unlabelled roofed utility unit at the lower end of the south large-pad western L-shaped service cluster. It is separate from existing small-pad service-small-s. Height and single-level count are LOW exterior estimates from the angled reference; exact function and interior floors are unconfirmed.

Unlabelled fixed utility unit immediately north of the central walkway crossing. Roof/body silhouette excludes cast shadow; may be a service cabinet rather than occupied hut. Height and single-level count are LOW exterior estimates from the angled reference; exact function and interior floors are unconfirmed.

Unlabelled pad-facing roofed service structure west of the main PWR footprint. The angled view suggests an open/service-gate component as well as a roofed equipment bay; opaque outline is approximate. Height and single-level count are LOW exterior estimates from the angled reference; exact function and interior floors are unconfirmed.

uncertain: Pad sizes are inferred from appearance; the image does not print S/M/L. The two larger pads may instead be medium. Fingerprint counts encode the low-confidence chosen classification, not verified journal data.
Absolute metres per pixel depend on assumed small pad dimensions, which may not describe the Odyssey painted apron exactly; use pixel coordinates as authoritative.
Roof heights and floor counts are low-confidence estimates from the oblique image; elevations are relative to each building local ground/platform and exclude terrain height.
Some inner-door icons show 1 with one caret, others 1 with two vertically stacked carets. Text is represented as 1^ and 1^^; no floor is assigned from these symbols.
Marker circles hide roof details and may be editorially offset from the physical console/door. at records the icon centre exactly, not a surveyed in-game coordinate.
The large exterior pad shapes trace painted rectangular bounds; service sheds, corner stripes and circular touchdown rings are not part of the pad outline.
Building shapes trace visible main structure/roof outlines; hidden under-eave ground walls cannot be recovered from these images.
Orange i is retained as map UI for completeness and should not be placed in a navigable settlement model.
No point has an independently verified physical storey from these two views; floor is null even when its icon shows an access number, L0, > L0 or carets.
All at coordinates are the printed annotation centres; editorial placement can be offset from the physical object. Some touching circles are individually recorded.
The orange top-left information button is retained as scope map_ui for complete icon transcription, and should not be drawn as a physical settlement object.

previous_scale.how: Assume a nominal small pad is 66 m long by 55 m wide. pad-small-n painted boundary spans 160 px horizontally and 136 px vertically: mean(66/160,55/136)=0.408 m/px, rounded to 0.41. This is a community pad-size assumption, not a measured Odyssey settlement dimension; the much larger apron does not independently confirm the same scale.
previous_scale.notes: Whole-image scale is approximate; camera foreshortening, painted vs structural boundaries and differences from station hangar pads can affect it. Height estimates are independent visual estimates.

Colonisation.metric_height_policy: Prior roof/storey/equipment height estimates are retained, with their original confidence/basis. The revised pad-based registration updates horizontal metres and visible footprint dimensions.

previous_scale.limitations: Approximate pad-boundary calibration. Separate X/Y conversion is required; nominal m_per_px alone does not reproduce the metric geometry. Heights are not recalibrated.

geometry_m.superseded_note: Kept for traceability. site_m holds the plan fitted to SrvSurvey's measured positions, in SrvSurvey's site frame.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.
